findAccountSlot.description: Which signed-in account slot (authuser index) owns an email address. Navigates /mail/u/<n>/ for n=0..maxSlots-1 and matches document.title against the address.

prepareDraftAs.description: Open a prefilled compose (view=cm) in the given account slot and switch the sender to a send-as alias (e.g. a Google Group address). Never sends. The From selector is hidden on this view: real Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks (not element.click()) on the To row, then the revealed From line, then the alias option are required to change it. Returns a readback of To/Subject/From for the caller to verify before calling sendPreparedDraft.

alias.description: substring identifying the send-as option, e.g. the alias address or "Team Dwarves"

returns.description: {targetId, to, subject, from:[...values]} on success; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

sendPreparedDraft.description: WRITE, irreversible. Click Send on a draft opened by prepareDraftAs. Refuses unless confirm:true: this is the point past which the message is outward and cannot be recalled, so the caller must have already read back prepareDraftAs's {to, subject, from} and gotten the human's explicit go-ahead.

confirm.description: must be true; a human has approved From/To/Subject

returns.description: {sent: true} once the compose view closes after the click; {stop:reason} otherwise

verifySent.description: Confirm a message reached Sent by searching in:sent to:<recipient> newer_than:<days>d and counting result rows.

searchRows.description: Open a Gmail search in a background tab and read the result-list rows as text. Uses textContent, not innerText: a background tab returns empty innerText for every row after the first.

returns.description: {rows: string[]} each row whitespace-collapsed and truncated to 200 chars

readThread.description: Open a Gmail search, click the first result row, expand the whole thread, and return its messages, attachment names, and outbound links. Same search+background-tab mechanics as searchRows.

query.description: Gmail search operators that should resolve to one thread

returns.description: {attachments: string[], links: string[] (non-mail.google.com hrefs), messages: string[]} on a hit; {stop:"no-results", hint} when the search returns nothing

composeDraft.description: Open a prefilled compose (view=cm) with To/Cc/Bcc/Subject/Body and optional attachments. Never sends -- Gmail auto-saves the open compose as a draft. Returns a readback to verify before any further action.

returns.description: {targetId, from, recipients: [data-hovercard-id values], subject, attachments: [filenames seen], body: first 200 chars}; {targetId, stop:"no-file-input"} if attachments were given but the file input was not found

replaceDraftBody.description:
Replace the body of an already-open compose (targetId from composeDraft). Gmail's body enforces Trusted Types, so plain lines are written as real DOM text/
nodes (replaceChildren) and an HTML fragment goes through CDP DOM.setOuterHTML on a placeholder div, which bypasses Trusted Types because it is not a page-script innerHTML assignment.

lines.description:
plain-text lines, joined with
; exactly one of lines or html

html.description: an HTML fragment (e.g. a signature); exactly one of lines or html

returns.description: {length: number} body innerText length after the replace; {stop:reason} if the body editable or placeholder was not found
